1879302626.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of Victory into battle. This banner reduces power costs of those around it.

1879330274.name: Tanglemane

1879391458.name: Call to Arms: Archer (Elvish Longbow-maiden)
1879391458.desc: You enlist an Archer to assist you in battle.

1879417826.name: Steed of Bright Company

1879422306.name: Woodland Hart

1879464802.name: The King's Pony
